operations.description: Requires packages.manage in the platform scope, or reseller.packages.manage in an active reseller tenant scope; each scope sees and changes only the groups and packages it owns (owner_scope_id), and another owner's package returns permission_denied. Referenced package groups must exist and be active. Region and node-group UUIDs are currently opaque configuration references and are not validated against region or node-group resources. A reseller's main and backup line groups must be platform line groups granted to it (scope_may_use_line_group_460); an ungranted one returns 400 package_line_group_not_granted. A reseller price below the wholesale price of its line groups in its price list returns 400 package_price_below_wholesale with details period, price_minor, wholesale_minor and price_list.

fields.name: group_ids
fields.description: Active package-group UUIDs. These references are validated by the catalog service.

fields.name: region_id
fields.description: Opaque non-zero region UUID. The current catalog does not validate a backing region resource.

fields.name: node_group_id
fields.description: Opaque non-zero primary node-group UUID. The current catalog does not validate a backing node-group resource.

fields.name: backup_node_group_id
fields.description: Optional opaque backup node-group UUID; when set it must differ from node_group_id. No backing resource existence check is implemented yet.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Set false to disable the package in the product catalog.
